scripts.build:dev: node scripts/check-design-refs.mjs && vite build --mode development && node scripts/assert-build-target.mjs dev
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/check-design-refs.mjs && vite build --mode production && node scripts/assert-build-target.mjs prod
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/emu-guard.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-scriptally-test 'npx vitest run --config vitest.config.rules.ts'
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/emu-guard.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-scriptally-test 'npx vitest run --config vitest.config.emulator.ts'
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project prod
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase deploy --only hosting --config firebase.dev.json --project dev && firebase deploy --only functions:smartImportMap --project dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --only hosting --project prod && firebase deploy --only functions:smartImportMap --project prod
